Maria: Quick sync — I'm running a focused microbench to isolate overhead for streaming vs funcalls vs structured output. Seeing ~12-18% latency jitter on short seqs (seq=32/64) on A100. Posting raw from local run:

Maria: ```
bench: test_streaming_funcall_struct
model: gptx-7b-v1
hw: a100-80
seq=64 iters=1000
median latency: 24.3ms
p95: 41.2ms
p99: 62.7ms
streaming-only median: 20.1ms
funcall-only median: 22.4ms
structured-io-only median: 21.8ms
combined (stream+func+struct) median: 27.5ms
``` 

Kevin: Can you drop the PR/harness? Also did you pin the model hash and quant settings?

Maria: PR is here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1234
Run command I used:
```
./bench/run.sh --model=gptx-7b-v1 --hash=abc123 --quant=fp16 --mode=combined --seq=64 --iters=1000
```

Sam: Do you see the same on A10? I remember we saw worse tail for small batch sizes. Also what's the KV cache miss rate for combined runs?

Maria: A10 numbers are worse p95 ~55ms, will paste. KV cache miss logged as ~3-5% on these synthetic traces.

Julia: I can schedule a perf-queue run and allocate 2xA100. Want me to do that and attach flamegraphs? perf-bot can run with `--trace=kv,beam`.

perf-bot: Bench queued: job=perf-2026-04-05-871 id=pj_4421. Expected ~25 minutes. Results will be posted to the PR comment.

Kevin: Also add a micro-measure that toggles `continuous_batching` and `kv_prefetch` so we can see which optimization reduces the delta. A quick curl to simulate streaming funcall flow:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"mode":"streaming","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"call tool:weather()"}]}'
```

Maria: Great — I'll update PR with flags and a short reproducible script. Please review: at-mention @kevin @sam for perf review. Thanks!

Sam: I'll give it a run after lunch. :thumbsup:

Kevin: Ping me when results are posted and I'll do a quick scan of the flamegraphs.
